cues.en: Hello. I'm John Osterhout.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 John Osterhout。

cues.en: And in this video, I'm going to introduce the Raft consensus algorithm.
cues.zh: 在这段视频中，我将介绍 Raft 共识算法。

cues.en: The overall goal of Raft is to replicate a log of entries identically across a collection of servers. And this, in turn, is used to create what we call a replicated state machine.
cues.zh: Raft 的总体目标，是在一组服务器之间以完全相同的方式复制一份由条目组成的日志。反过来，这又被用来创建我们所说的复制状态机。

cues.en: Suppose you had a program or an application that you wanted to make reliable.
cues.zh: 假设你有一个程序或应用，想让它变得可靠。

cues.en: One way to do that is to execute that program on a collection of machines and ensure that they all execute in exactly the same way. That's the idea of a replicated state machine. So when I say state machine, I just mean a program or an application that takes inputs and produces outputs.
cues.zh: 一种办法是在一组机器上运行该程序，并确保它们都以完全相同的方式执行。这就是复制状态机的思路。所以我说状态机时，只是指一个接收输入并产生输出的程序或应用。

cues.en: Now, a log can help in order to make sure that those state machines execute exactly the same commands.
cues.zh: 现在，日志可以帮助确保这些状态机执行完全相同的命令。

cues.en: Here's how it works. If a client of the system wishes to execute a command, it passes that
cues.zh: 它是这样工作的：如果系统的某个客户端想执行一条命令，它会把它传给

cues.en: to one of those machines.
cues.zh: 其中一台机器。

cues.en: That command, let's call it x, then gets recorded in the log of the local machine.
cues.zh: 这条命令，我们称它为 x，随后会被记录到本地机器的日志中。

cues.en: And then in addition,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: the command is passed
cues.zh: 这条命令会被传给

cues.en: to the other machines
cues.zh: 其他机器

cues.en: and recorded in their logs as well.
cues.zh: 并记录到它们的日志中。

cues.en: Once the command has been safely replicated in the logs,
cues.zh: 一旦这条命令已安全地复制到日志中，

cues.en: then it can be passed
cues.zh: 就可以把它传给

cues.en: to the state machines for execution.
cues.zh: 状态机去执行。

cues.en: And when one of the state machines has finished executing the command, the result can be returned back to the client program again.
cues.zh: 当其中一个状态机执行完这条命令后，结果可以再返回给客户端程序。

cues.en: And you can see that as long as the logs in the machines are all identical,
cues.zh: 你可以看到，只要各台机器中的日志都完全相同，

cues.en: and the state machines on the on the different servers execute the same commands from the log in the same order, we know they're all going to produce the same results.
cues.zh: 并且不同服务器上的状态机按相同顺序执行日志中的相同命令，我们就知道它们都会产生相同的结果。

cues.en: So it's the job of the consensus module to manage those logs, ensure that they're properly replicated, and then determine when it's safe to pass the commands to the state machine for execution.
cues.zh: 管理这些日志、确保它们被正确复制，然后判断何时可以安全地把命令交给状态机执行，这是共识模块的职责。

cues.en: The reason we call this a consensus based approach is that we don't require all of the servers to be running at any given time. In fact, the system has to make progress as long as any majority of the servers are up and can communicate with each other. So for example, you might have a cluster of three servers. This could tolerate one server being down as long as two of the three are up. Or in a cluster of five servers, you could tolerate two servers being down as long as three are up.
cues.zh: 我们称之为基于共识的方法，原因是我们不要求所有服务器在任何时刻都在运行。事实上，只要任意多数服务器在线且能互相通信，系统就必须继续推进。比如，你可能有一个三台服务器的集群。只要三台中有两台在线，就能容忍一台宕机。或者在五台服务器的集群中，只要三台在线，就能容忍两台宕机。

cues.en: Now let me talk briefly about the failures that we expect the system to handle.
cues.zh: 现在让我简要谈谈我们期望系统处理的故障。

cues.en: We expect that servers can crash, but we expect them to do that in a fail stop way. That is they just stop operating.
cues.zh: 我们预期服务器会崩溃，但我们期望它们以故障停止的方式崩溃。也就是说，它们直接停止运行。

cues.en: Or they may pause operating and then resume later.
cues.zh: 或者它们可能暂停运行，稍后再恢复。

cues.en: But when they're running, they're behaving correctly.
cues.zh: 但只要它们在运行，行为就是正确的。

cues.en: So we don't, this protocol does not handle the situation
cues.zh: 所以这个协议不处理

cues.en: where a server has so called Byzantine behavior,
cues.zh: 服务器出现所谓拜占庭行为的情况，

cues.en: where it behaves maliciously.
cues.zh: 也就是恶意行为。

cues.en: We also assume that the network communications can be interrupted.
cues.zh: 我们还假设网络通信可能中断。

cues.en: Messages can be lost or delayed.
cues.zh: 消息可能丢失或延迟。

cues.en: They may arrive out of order.
cues.zh: 它们可能乱序到达。

cues.en: It is possible that the network could be partitioned for a while, and then the partition could go away later on.
cues.zh: 网络可能暂时被分区，之后分区可能消失。

cues.en: There are two general approaches that have been used to implement consensus algorithms.
cues.zh: 实现共识算法通常有两种常见方法。

cues.en: The first approach is called symmetric or leaderless.
cues.zh: 第一种方法称为对称式或无主式。

cues.en: In this approach,
cues.zh: 在这种方法中，

cues.en: all the servers have the same roles, they all have equal power, behave roughly the same at any given time. They're all they're all very equal. A client can contact any server
cues.zh: 所有服务器角色相同，权力相等，在任何时刻行为大致一样。它们完全平等。客户端可以联系任意服务器

cues.en: to add a command of a log and get it replicated.
cues.zh: 来添加日志命令并使其复制。

cues.en: The second approach is called asymmetric or leader based. The servers are not equal at any given time. At any time, one of them is the leader.
cues.zh: 第二种方法称为非对称式或基于领导者。服务器在任何时刻并不平等。任何时候，其中一个是领导者。

cues.en: It's in charge, typically manages all of the operation of the clusters, and the other servers are subservient, simply carrying out the wishes of the leader.
cues.zh: 它负责管理，通常掌管集群的所有操作，其他服务器则服从，只是执行领导者的意愿。

cues.en: In this sort of a system, the clients always communicate with the leader. Only the leader talks with the other servers.
cues.zh: 在这种系统中，客户端总是与领导者通信。只有领导者与其他服务器交流。

cues.en: Now Raft uses that second leader based approach.
cues.zh: 而Raft采用第二种基于领导者的方法。

cues.en: And this
cues.zh: 并且这

cues.en: decomposes
cues.zh: 将

cues.en: the problem of the consensus algorithm into two different things. One is the normal operation when there's a leader
cues.zh: 共识算法的问题分解为两个不同部分。一是存在正常运行的领导者时的常规操作

cues.en: that's properly running. And then the second part is what do you do when the leader crashes or you have to elect a new leader.
cues.zh: 。第二部分是当领导者崩溃或需要选举新领导者时该怎么办。

cues.en: This approach has the advantage that it makes the normal operation very simple. You don't have to worry about different leaders conflicting with each other,
cues.zh: 这种方法的好处是使常规操作非常简单。你不必担心不同领导者相互冲突，

cues.en: or trying to do things at the same time. There's one person in charge, and they can do exactly what they want.
cues.zh: 或同时尝试做事。只有一个人负责，他们可以完全按自己的意愿行事。

cues.en: All of the complexity in RAFT, as you'll see, comes from leader changes.
cues.zh: 在RAFT中，所有的复杂性，如你将会看到的，都源自领导者变更。

cues.en: That's particularly true because if a leader crashes, it may leave the system in an inconsistent state that the next leader has to clean up.
cues.zh: 这一点尤为正确，因为如果领导者崩溃，它可能会使系统处于不一致状态，而下一任领导者必须清理这一状态。

cues.en: In general, the leader based approaches are more efficient than the leaderless approaches,
cues.zh: 一般而言，基于领导者的方法比无领导者的方法更高效，

cues.en: because you don't have to worry about these conflicts between
cues.zh: 因为你无需担心任何时刻服务器之间的这些冲突

cues.en: servers at any given time. You only have to deal with those during leader changes.
cues.zh: 只有在领导者变更时，你才需要处理这些问题。

cues.en: I'm going to explain RAFT in six parts.
cues.zh: 我将分六部分来解释RAFT。

cues.en: First, I will talk about leader election.
cues.zh: 首先，我会讲讲领导者选举。

cues.en: How do we choose out of all of the servers one of them that will be the leader? And then when that machine crashes, how do we detect that and pick a different leader to replace it?
cues.zh: 我们如何从所有服务器中选出一台作为领导者？然后，当那台机器崩溃时，我们如何检测并选择另一台领导者来替代它？

cues.en: Second, I'll talk about the normal operation of the system where a leader is receiving requests from clients and replicating them. That's actually the simplest part of the RAFT system.
cues.zh: 其次，我会讲讲系统的正常操作，即领导者接收来自客户端的请求并进行复制。这实际上是RAFT系统中最简单的部分。

cues.en: Third,
cues.zh: 第三，

cues.en: I'll talk about leader changes. This is probably the trickiest part and the most crucial in terms of guaranteeing the overall behavior of the system. I'll first talk about what it means for RAF to be safe, how we ensure that. And second,
cues.zh: 我会讲讲领导者变更。这部分可能是最棘手的，对于保证系统整体行为至关重要。我会先讲讲RAFT安全意味着什么，我们如何确保这一点。然后，

cues.en: how leaders resolve log inconsistencies
cues.zh: 领导者如何解决日志不一致

cues.en: in order to restore the system back to a consistent state again.
cues.zh: 以使系统恢复到一致状态。

cues.en: Fourth, I'll talk about another issue related to leader changes, which is how do we keep an old leader that isn't actually dead from coming back to haunt us?
cues.zh: 第四，我会讲讲与领导者变更相关的另一个问题，即如何防止一个实际上并未死亡的老领导者回来捣乱？

cues.en: Fifth,
cues.zh: 第五，

cues.en: I'll give a little bit more information about how clients interact with the system. And the key issue here is how do clients deal with server crashes and how do we make sure that we have what are called linearizable semantics, where each client operation is executed once and exactly once.
cues.zh: 我会多讲一点客户端如何与系统交互。关键问题是客户端如何处理服务器崩溃，以及如何确保所谓的线性一致性语义：每个客户端操作都恰好执行一次。

cues.en: And then finally, I'll about talk how we deal with configuration changes. That is, how do we add or remove servers to the cluster that is managing the Raft system.
cues.zh: 最后，我会讲我们如何处理配置变更。也就是，如何向管理 Raft 系统的集群中添加或移除服务器。

cues.en: Before going into details of those six parts of Raft, let me first provide some overall information.
cues.zh: 在深入 Raft 这六个部分的细节之前，我先提供一些总体信息。

cues.en: At any given time, a server is in one of three states.
cues.zh: 任意时刻，服务器都处于三种状态之一。

cues.en: The first state I've already described. That's the leader state. We need to make sure there's only one of these at a time.
cues.zh: 第一种状态我已经描述过，就是领导者状态。我们需要确保同一时间只有一个领导者。

cues.en: The second state is follower state. We expect most of the servers to be in follower state most of the time. These servers are completely passive. They issue no remote procedure calls at all. All they do is respond to remote procedure calls coming from other servers.
cues.zh: 第二种状态是跟随者状态。我们预计大多数服务器大多数时间都处于跟随者状态。这些服务器完全被动。它们完全不发起远程过程调用。它们只响应来自其他服务器的远程过程调用。

cues.en: The third state is called candidate state.
cues.zh: 第三种状态称为候选者状态。

cues.en: This is a state intermediate between follower and leader,
cues.zh: 这是跟随者和领导者之间的中间状态，

cues.en: and is used temporarily
cues.zh: 并且是临时使用的，

cues.en: during elections to pick a new leader.
cues.zh: 在选举期间用来选出新领导者。

cues.en: In normal operation of the system, there will be exactly one leader, and all of the other servers will be followers.
cues.zh: 在系统正常运行时，会恰好有一个领导者，其他所有服务器都是跟随者。

cues.en: At the bottom of the slide, I've shown a state diagram of these states and the transitions between them. I'm not going to go over those now, but you may find those useful to refer to as I go through the details of the algorithm in the later slides.
cues.zh: 在幻灯片底部，我展示了这些状态及它们之间转换的状态图。我现在不打算过一遍，但在后续幻灯片讲解算法细节时，你可能会发现它很有用。

cues.en: Time is divided into terms. Each term has a number, and these numbers increment and are never reused.
cues.zh: 时间被划分为任期。每个任期有一个编号，编号递增且从不重复。

cues.en: Each term has two parts. First, a term starts with an election. That is, this is a a process that picks a leader for the term. And then if the election is successful,
cues.zh: 每个任期分为两部分。首先，任期以选举开始，即一个为任期选出领导者的过程。如果选举成功，

cues.en: then the chosen leader will serve out for the rest of the term as the leader.
cues.zh: 那么选出的领导者将在剩余任期内担任领导者。

cues.en: As you'll see, RAF guarantees
cues.zh: 如你所见，Raft 保证

cues.en: that only one server can be elected leader in a term. However,
cues.zh: 在一个任期内只能选出一个服务器作为领导者。然而，

cues.en: there can be some terms
cues.zh: 可能存在某些任期

cues.en: where no leader is chosen. This happens if the votes are split in a way that no leader can get a majority of the votes.
cues.zh: 没有选出领导者。这种情况发生在选票被分散，以至于没有领导者能获得多数票时。

cues.en: When this happens, then the system immediately
cues.zh: 发生这种情况时，系统会立即

cues.en: moves to a new term to try again to pick a leader.
cues.zh: 进入新任期，重新尝试选出领导者。

cues.en: Each server in the RAFT system
cues.zh: RAFT 系统中的每个服务器

cues.en: maintains
cues.zh: 维护

cues.en: a value called the current term, which is its best guess
cues.zh: 一个称为当前任期的值，这是它对

cues.en: about what the current term in the system is. And by the way, that information has to be stored
cues.zh: 系统中当前任期的最佳猜测。顺便说一下，这个信息必须

cues.en: reliably on that server's disk so that it can be recovered when the server crashes and restarts.
cues.zh: 可靠地存储在服务器的磁盘上，以便在服务器崩溃并重启后能够恢复。

cues.en: The role that term serve is a really important one. It allows Raft to identify information that's out of date. For example, if a server that currently believes that the term number is two
cues.zh: 任期的作用非常重要。它让 Raft 能够识别过时的信息。例如，如果一个当前认为任期编号为 2 的服务器

cues.en: communicates with the server that currently believes the term number is three, then we know that the information coming from that first server is out of date. We only want to use the information from the latest term. So as we go through the talk, you'll see several situations where terms are used to detect and eliminate information that's no longer up to date.
cues.zh: 与一个当前认为任期编号为 3 的服务器通信，那么我们就知道来自第一个服务器的信息是过时的。我们只想使用最新任期的信息。因此，在接下来的讲解中，你会看到多种情况，任期被用来检测和消除不再最新的信息。

cues.en: This slide contains a complete summary of the entire RAFT protocol.
cues.zh: 这张幻灯片完整总结了整个 RAFT 协议。

cues.en: I'm not going to go over it in detail now, but I just want to point out a few general features you can come back to later on. So first, the slide describes what each of the three roles does, followers, candidates, and leaders.
cues.zh: 我现在不详细讲了，只想指出几个总体特征，你们之后可以再回来看。首先，这张幻灯片描述了三种角色各自做什么：follower、candidate 和 leader。

cues.en: Second, it describes what information has to be stored persistently on the disks of the servers.
cues.zh: 第二，它描述了哪些信息必须持久存储在服务器的磁盘上。

cues.en: And then third, it describes how the servers communicate.
cues.zh: 第三，它描述了服务器之间如何通信。

cues.en: All communication in RAFT is done via remote procedure calls,
cues.zh: RAFT 中所有通信都通过远程过程调用完成，

cues.en: and there are only two of them.
cues.zh: 而且只有两种。

cues.en: There's one RPC called request vote that's used during elections to pick a leader, and one RPC
cues.zh: 一种叫 request vote，用于选举期间选出 leader；另一种

cues.en: that's used by the leader during normal operations to replicate log entries. These are the only two RPCs in the system. And by the way, I'll just mention briefly, each of these is idempotent, which has some nice properties in terms of handling replicated and lost messages and so on.
cues.zh: 由 leader 在正常运行时用来复制日志条目。这就是系统中的仅有的两种 RPC。顺便简单提一下，这两种都是幂等的，这在处理重复和丢失消息等方面有一些很好的特性。

cues.en: Again, I'm not gonna go over the details here, but you may want to refer back to these as I go through details later on in the talk.
cues.zh: 同样，这里我不讲细节，但后面讲细节时你们可以回来看这些内容。

cues.en: Okay, now let's go through the six components of the Raft protocol.
cues.zh: 好，现在我们来过一遍 Raft 协议的六个组成部分。

cues.en: The first component of the protocol is elections. Raft has to make sure that at any given time, there's exactly one machine acting as a leader in the cluster.
cues.zh: 协议的第一部分是选举。Raft 必须确保在任何时刻，集群中都恰好有一台机器作为 leader。

cues.en: Now when a server starts up,
cues.zh: 当一台服务器启动时，

cues.en: it begins as a follower.
cues.zh: 它一开始是 follower。

cues.en: And in this state, it doesn't attempt to communicate with anyone else. Followers are completely passive. They simply respond to incoming remote procedure calls from other machines.
cues.zh: 在这种状态下，它不会试图与其他机器通信。跟随者完全是被动的，只会响应其他机器发来的远程过程调用。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 不过，

cues.en: in order for a follower to stay a follower, it has to believe that there is an active leader in the cluster.
cues.zh: 要让跟随者继续保持跟随者状态，它必须相信集群中有一位活跃的领导者。

cues.en: And the only way it can know that is if it receives communications from other machines that are either leaders or candidates.
cues.zh: 而它唯一能确认这一点的办法，就是收到其他机器发来的通信；这些机器要么是领导者，要么是候选者。

cues.en: So if the leader wants to maintain its authority, it must communicate with all of the other machines in the cluster on a regular basis. And if it has no other reason for communicating with them, it must send heartbeat messages.
cues.zh: 所以，领导者若想维持自己的权威，就必须定期与集群中的所有其他机器通信。如果没有其他通信需求，就必须发送心跳消息。

cues.en: In Raft, these are simply append entries, remote procedure calls that contain no data at all, so those serve as heartbeat messages.
cues.zh: 在 Raft 中，心跳消息就是不包含任何数据的 AppendEntries 远程过程调用。

cues.en: If a period of time goes by and a follower does not receive any remote procedure calls,
cues.zh: 如果过了一段时间，跟随者仍未收到任何远程过程调用，

cues.en: then it assumes that there is no viable leader in the cluster. And so it starts an election to see if perhaps it should become leader.
cues.zh: 它就会认为集群中没有可用的领导者，于是发起选举，看看自己是否应该成为领导者。

cues.en: This period of time that a follower wait is called the election timeout.
cues.zh: 跟随者等待的这段时间称为选举超时。

cues.en: In the typical clusters, that'll be in the range of a hundred to five hundred milliseconds.
cues.zh: 在典型的集群中，这个超时通常在 100 到 500 毫秒之间。

cues.en: So when the cluster first starts up,
cues.zh: 所以，集群刚启动时，

cues.en: all of the servers will begin as followers. There'll be no leader, and so they'll all wait this election timeout period, and then they'll all start elections to elect a leader.
cues.zh: 所有服务器都会先成为跟随者。此时没有领导者，所以它们都会等待选举超时，然后同时发起选举，选出一位领导者。

cues.en: Now let's talk about how an election works.
cues.zh: 现在我们来谈谈选举是如何进行的。

cues.en: When a server begins an election, the first thing it does is to increment its current term value. This produces a new value for the term larger than anything it has seen before. And remember, the first thing that happens in every new term is we hold an election.
cues.zh: 当服务器开始一次选举时，它做的第一件事就是递增当前的任期值。这会产生一个比它之前见过的任何值都大的新任期值。记住，每个新任期里发生的第一件事就是我们举行一次选举。

cues.en: The server then converts itself from follower state to candidate state.
cues.zh: 然后该服务器将自己从跟随者状态转换为候选者状态。

cues.en: In this state, its goal is to get itself elected as leader. And in order to do that, it needs to receive votes from a majority of the servers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 在这个状态下，它的目标是让自己被选举为领导者。为了做到这一点，它需要获得集群中多数服务器的投票。

cues.en: The first thing the candidate does
cues.zh: 候选者做的第一件事

cues.en: is that it votes for itself.
cues.zh: 就是给自己投票。

cues.en: Then it sends out remote procedure calls to all of the other servers asking them for their votes.
cues.zh: 然后它向所有其他服务器发送远程过程调用，请求它们投票。

cues.en: Typically, will send these request vote RPCs
cues.zh: 通常，它会发送这些请求投票的RPC

cues.en: in parallel to all of the servers.
cues.zh: 并行地发给所有服务器。

cues.en: If it doesn't get a response from any particular server, it will keep retrying with that server over and over again until it eventually gets a response.
cues.zh: 如果它没有从某个特定服务器得到响应，它会不断向该服务器重试，直到最终得到响应。

cues.en: Sooner or later, one of three things will happen.
cues.zh: 迟早会发生三种情况之一。

cues.en: First, the thing we happen most of the hope to happen most of the time
cues.zh: 第一种，也是我们大多数时候最希望发生的情况

cues.en: is that the candidate will get votes from a majority of the servers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 就是候选者获得集群中多数服务器的投票。

cues.en: When this happens, then it converts itself to leader state and immediately sends out heartbeat messages to all of the other servers,
cues.zh: 发生这种情况时，它就会将自己转换为领导者状态，并立即向所有其他服务器发送心跳消息，

cues.en: which effectively marks its territory or establishes itself as leader.
cues.zh: 这实际上是在标记自己的领地，或确立自己作为领导者的地位。

cues.en: The second thing that could happen during an election is that there could be some other candidate also operating at the same time, and perhaps that candidate receives enough votes to become leader, at which point it will send out RPCs.
cues.zh: 选举期间可能发生的第二种情况是，同时可能有其他候选人在竞选，也许那个候选人获得了足够的选票成为领导者，此时它就会发出 RPC。

cues.en: And so if a candidate receives a remote procedure call from a valid leader,
cues.zh: 因此，如果某个候选人收到了来自合法领导者的远程过程调用，

cues.en: then it immediately
cues.zh: 它就会立刻

cues.en: gives up its attempt to become leader. We call that stepping down, which causes it to return to follower state, becomes passive, and simply responds to the request from the valid leader.
cues.zh: 放弃成为领导者的尝试。我们称之为退位，这会使其回到跟随者状态，变为被动，只响应来自合法领导者的请求。

cues.en: Then the third state or third outcome that can happen
cues.zh: 然后可能发生的第三种状态或第三种结果

cues.en: is that it's possible no one will win the election.
cues.zh: 是可能没有人能赢得选举。

cues.en: If several
cues.zh: 如果几个

cues.en: servers convert to candidate about the same time, they could split the votes in a way that nobody can get a majority of the cluster's votes.
cues.zh: 服务器几乎同时转为候选人，它们可能会分散选票，导致没有人能获得集群的多数票。

cues.en: The way that a server detects
cues.zh: 服务器检测

cues.en: this possibility
cues.zh: 这种情况

cues.en: is that a period of time goes by and neither of the other two options has occurred yet. In fact, uses the same election timeout period.
cues.zh: 的方式是，过了一段时间，另外两种结果都还没有发生。事实上，使用的是相同的选举超时时间。

cues.en: If that elapses and this
cues.zh: 如果超时了，而这个

cues.en: candidate has not become leader and has not heard from a valid leader,
cues.zh: 候选人既没有成为领导者，也没有收到合法领导者的消息，

cues.en: then it assumes that there's a split vote in the election.
cues.zh: 那么它就认为选举中出现了分票。

cues.en: And so at this point, it simply goes back to the beginning and starts
cues.zh: 所以此时，它直接回到起点，开始

cues.en: a new election
cues.zh: 新一轮选举

cues.en: by incrementing the term and starting the whole process over again.
cues.zh: 通过增加任期并重新开始整个过程。

cues.en: It's important for an election to have two properties, safety and liveness.
cues.zh: 选举具有两个重要特性：安全性和活性。

cues.en: The safety property says that there must be at most one candidate that wins the election in a given term.
cues.zh: 安全性属性要求，在给定任期内，最多只能有一个候选人赢得选举。

cues.en: The way Raft guarantees this is that each server
cues.zh: Raft 保证这一点的方式是，每个服务器

cues.en: only gives out its vote once to a single candidate.
cues.zh: 只把票投给一个候选人，且仅投一次。

cues.en: Once it's given its vote, it will refuse requests from any other candidates for votes. And and by the way, the server doesn't really care which server gives its vote to. It'll give it to the first candidate that comes along.
cues.zh: 一旦投出选票，它就会拒绝任何其他候选人的投票请求。顺便说一句，服务器其实并不关心把票投给哪个服务器，它会投给第一个找上门的候选人。

cues.en: In order to make this work,
cues.zh: 为了让这一机制生效，

cues.en: the server needs to make sure that it saves information about its vote on some durable medium like disk, so it can recover that after a crash. Otherwise, we'd have a problem where a server might give out its vote, and then crash and then restart and give its vote again to a different server for the same term.
cues.zh: 服务器需要确保把投票信息保存在某种持久介质上，比如磁盘，这样崩溃后还能恢复。否则就会出现问题：服务器投出选票后崩溃，重启后又把同一任期的票投给另一个服务器。

cues.en: Given that a server's only giving out one vote
cues.zh: 既然一个服务器只投出一票，

cues.en: and given that each candidate has to get a majority of the votes, then it's easy to see that you can't have two candidates that win an election.
cues.zh: 而每个候选人必须获得多数票，那么很容易看出，不可能有两个候选人同时赢得选举。

cues.en: So for example, if three servers vote for a in a particular term,
cues.zh: 举例来说，如果在某个任期内有三个服务器投票给 a，

cues.en: then the most that any other server could get,
cues.zh: 那么其他任何服务器最多只能拿到

cues.en: say b, is two, and obviously b can't get a majority.
cues.zh: 比如 b，两票，显然 b 无法获得多数。

cues.en: Now as we'll see later on, it is possible, of course, to have different candidates win in different terms.
cues.zh: 正如我们后面会看到的，当然，不同任期由不同候选人赢得是可能的。

cues.en: But within a given term, at most one candidate can win an election.
cues.zh: 但在给定任期内，最多只有一个候选人能赢得选举。

cues.en: Now the second property is the liveness property.
cues.zh: 第二个属性是活性属性。

cues.en: We need to make sure that somebody wins so the system doesn't stay in a state with no leader forever.
cues.zh: 我们必须确保有人胜出，这样系统就不会一直处于没有领导者的状态。

cues.en: And the problem is that we could in principle
cues.zh: 问题在于，我们原则上可能会

cues.en: have repeated split votes
cues.zh: 出现反复的投票分裂

cues.en: where a bunch of candidates all start elections for the same term at the same time. They split the votes.
cues.zh: 即一群候选人在同一任期同时发起选举，导致选票被分散。

cues.en: They all time out again, start a new election in a new term, split the votes again, and so on. And in principle, this could go on indefinitely.
cues.zh: 他们又都超时了，在新任期重新发起选举，选票再次被分散，如此循环。原则上，这可以无限持续下去。

cues.en: The way that RAFT presents this is to spread out the election time outs.
cues.zh: RAFT 的做法是分散选举超时时间。

cues.en: Each server
cues.zh: 每台服务器

cues.en: computes its next timeout
cues.zh: 计算自己的下一次超时时间

cues.en: randomly in an interval,
cues.zh: 在一个区间内随机选取，

cues.en: an interval between a particular value t and twice that value, where t is typically what we refer to as, that's the election timeout. So the smaller, the the fastest that a machine could possibly time out.
cues.zh: 这个区间介于某个特定值 t 和它的两倍之间，t 通常就是我们所说的选举超时时间。也就是一台机器可能超时最短的时间。

cues.en: By spreading out these time outs,
cues.zh: 通过分散这些超时时间，

cues.en: that makes it unlikely that two servers will wake up at the same time. Whoever wakes up first will have enough time to request the votes from everybody else and win the election before anybody else wakes up to compete with it.
cues.zh: 两台服务器同时醒来的可能性就很小了。最先醒来的那台会有足够的时间向其他所有服务器请求投票，并在其他服务器醒来竞争之前赢得选举。

cues.en: And this works particularly well
cues.zh: 这种方法效果特别好，

cues.en: if that time over which we spread the the timeouts
cues.zh: 前提是我们分散超时时间的那个时间跨度

cues.en: is much larger than the broadcast time where... What I mean by broadcast time is the amount of time that it takes one server to talk to all the other servers that get their votes.
cues.zh: 远大于广播时间……我说的广播时间，是指一台服务器与所有其他参与投票的服务器通信所需的时间。

cues.en: So as long as
cues.zh: 所以只要

cues.en: the time outs are spread out over a much larger interval, again, it's pretty easy to see that whichever server wakes up first
cues.zh: 超时时间分散在一个大得多的区间上，同样很容易看出，最先醒来的那台服务器

cues.en: will be able to talk to everybody and get their votes before anybody else wakes up.
cues.zh: 就能在其他服务器醒来之前与所有服务器通信并获得它们的投票。

cues.en: Now let's move on to the second part of the RAFT protocol,
cues.zh: 接下来我们进入RAFT协议的第二部分，

cues.en: which is the mechanism that leaders use during normal operation to replicate log entries.
cues.zh: 也就是领导者在正常运行时用来复制日志条目的机制。

cues.en: First, let's talk a little bit about the log.
cues.zh: 首先，我们简单聊聊日志。

cues.en: Each server stores its own individual copy of a log. So the leader has a copy, and each follower
cues.zh: 每个服务器都存储着自己独立的一份日志副本。所以领导者有一份副本，而每个跟随者

cues.en: has its own private copy of a log.
cues.zh: 都有自己私有的日志副本。

cues.en: The log is divided up into entries,
cues.zh: 日志被划分为一个个条目，

cues.en: and entries are identified by an index, which gives their position
cues.zh: 条目通过索引来标识，索引给出了它们在日志中的位置

cues.en: in the log.
Inside an entry, there are two things.
cues.zh: 在一个条目内部，有两样东西。

cues.en: First, each entry contains a command for the state machine.
cues.zh: 首先，每个条目包含一条给状态机的命令。

cues.en: The format of this is really up to the clients of the state machines to agree on. On. Consensus module doesn't care. But you can imagine, it might be something like the name of a procedure and some arguments to pass to that procedure.
cues.zh: 这个格式实际上由状态机的客户端自行约定。共识模块并不关心。但你可以想象，它可能是某个过程的名字以及传给该过程的一些参数。

cues.en: Then in addition,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: each entry in the log contains a term number.
cues.zh: 日志中的每个条目还包含一个任期号。

cues.en: This is the term number when the log, when that entry was first created
cues.zh: 这是该条目最初被

cues.en: by the leader of that term.
cues.zh: 那个任期的领导者创建时的任期号。

cues.en: And these term numbers increase monotonically as you go up the log.
cues.zh: 而且这些任期号沿着日志向上是单调递增的。

cues.en: Each server has to guarantee that its log will survive crashes. So the log is typically stored on disk or some other form of stable storage.
cues.zh: 每个服务器都必须保证其日志能在崩溃后存活。所以日志通常存储在磁盘或其他形式的稳定存储上。

cues.en: And whenever
cues.zh: 而且每当

cues.en: a server makes a modification to its log, it has to update the safe copy on disk before it returns any sort of response to anybody else in the system.
cues.zh: 服务器对其日志做出修改时，它必须先更新磁盘上的安全副本，然后才能向系统中其他任何一方返回任何形式的响应。

cues.en: If a particular log entry happens to be stored on a majority of the servers in the cluster,
cues.zh: 如果某个日志条目恰好存储在集群中大多数服务器上，

cues.en: such as, say,
cues.zh: 比如，

cues.en: entry seven here, then we say that that entry is committed.
cues.zh: 这里的第七条，那么我们就说该条目已提交。

cues.en: This is a very important property
cues.zh: 这是非常重要的一个特性

cues.en: of the RAFT system.
cues.zh: 属于 RAFT 系统。

cues.en: If an entry is committed, then it's safe for that entry to be passed to state machines for execution. RAFT will guarantee that the entry is durable,
cues.zh: 如果某个条目已提交，那么就可以安全地把它交给状态机执行。RAFT 会保证该条目持久化，

cues.en: and sooner or later, that entry will be executed by every state machine on every server in the cluster.
cues.zh: 而且迟早，集群中每台服务器上的每个状态机都会执行这个条目。

cues.en: So in this picture, entry seven is committed. In fact, all entries
cues.zh: 所以在这张图里，第七项已提交。事实上，所有条目

cues.en: preceding entry seven are committed. But entry eight is not yet committed since it's only stored on two of the five servers. Now I just wanna warn you, I'm gonna modify this definition of commitment slightly
cues.zh: 前面的七个条目已经提交了。但第八个条目尚未提交，因为它只存储在五个服务器中的两个上。现在我想提醒大家，我将稍微修改一下这个提交的定义Now I just wanna warn you, I'm gonna modify this definition of commitment slightly

cues.en: when we get to the part of the talk on managing consistency of logs across server changes.
cues.zh: 等讲到在服务器变更时维护日志一致性那部分。

cues.en: Normal operation is pretty simple.
cues.zh: 正常运行其实很简单。

cues.en: The client sends a command to the leader that it would like to have executed by all of the state machines.
cues.zh: 客户端向领导者发送一条命令，希望它由所有状态机执行。

cues.en: The leader first adds that command to its own log,
cues.zh: 领导者首先将该命令添加到自己的日志中，

cues.en: and then it issues append entries remote procedure calls to the followers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 然后它会向集群中的跟随者发起追加条目的远程过程调用。

cues.en: Typically, it will execute these RPCs in parallel, sending the same message to all of them at the same time.
cues.zh: 通常，它会并行执行这些 RPC，同时把同一条消息发给所有节点。

cues.en: And then it waits for the responses to come back.
cues.zh: 然后等待响应返回。

cues.en: Once the leader has received enough responses
cues.zh: 一旦领导者收到足够多的响应

cues.en: to consider that entry committed,
cues.zh: 足以认为该条目已提交，

cues.en: that is it's gotten responses from
cues.zh: 也就是说，它已经收到了来自……的回应

cues.en: at least half of the other servers in the cluster, so with itself that makes a majority,
cues.zh: 至少占集群中其他服务器的一半，再加上它自己就构成了多数派，

cues.en: then it's okay to execute the command. So the leader passes the command off to its state machine. That command finishes, then it returns the result back to the client.
cues.zh: 这时就可以执行该命令了。于是 Leader 把命令交给自己的状态机。命令执行完毕后，再把结果返回给客户端。

cues.en: Furthermore, once the leader knows that a particular entry is committed,
cues.zh: 此外，一旦领导者知道某个特定条目已提交，

cues.en: it notifies the other servers about that
cues.zh: 它会在后续的追加条目RPC中通知其他服务器

cues.en: in subsequent append entries RPCs.
cues.zh: 这一情况。

cues.en: So eventually each of the followers will also find out that that entry has been committed,
cues.zh: 因此最终每个跟随者也会得知该条目已经提交，

cues.en: and then the followers, when they find out, they will execute that command on their state machines also.
cues.zh: 然后跟随者在得知后，也会在自己的状态机上执行该命令。

cues.en: Now if a follower has crashed or is slow to respond to an append entry's remote procedure call,
cues.zh: 现在，如果某个跟随者崩溃了，或者对追加条目的远程过程调用响应缓慢，

cues.en: the leader will keep retrying that call over and over and over again. So if a follower crashes and it comes back up again, the leader will retry it.
cues.zh: 领导者会不断重试该调用，一遍又一遍。因此，如果跟随者崩溃后又重新启动，领导者会重试。

cues.en: But the leader doesn't have to wait for every single follower to respond. It only needs enough to respond to guarantee that the entry is stored on a majority of the servers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 但领导者不必等待每一个跟随者都响应。它只需要足够多的响应，以确保条目存储在集群中多数服务器上。

cues.en: So this results in very good performance in the common case. In the normal case, all that's needed in order to finish a client command is to get a response back from a majority of the servers, in fact, fastest machines in the cluster,
cues.zh: 因此，在常见情况下，这带来了非常好的性能。正常情况下，完成客户端命令只需获得多数服务器的响应，实际上，是集群中最快的机器，

cues.en: at which point the leader can immediately execute the command and return the result to the client. So, for example, one slow server doesn't necessarily slow down the clients because the leader doesn't have to wait for that server.
cues.zh: 此时领导者可以立即执行命令并将结果返回给客户端。所以，例如，一个慢速服务器不一定拖慢客户端，因为领导者不必等待那个服务器。

cues.en: Raft tries to maintain a high level of consistency between the various logs in a cluster. Ideally, they'd all be identical at all times, and we can't of course do that, given there can be crashes.
cues.zh: Raft试图在集群中各日志之间保持高度一致性。理想情况下，它们始终完全相同，当然，考虑到可能发生崩溃，我们无法做到这一点。

cues.en: But as much as possible, RAF tries to keep the logs identical. And this slide lists some properties that are always true at all times.
cues.zh: 但 RAF 会尽可能保持日志一致。这张幻灯片列出了始终成立的一些性质。

cues.en: The first property
cues.zh: 第一个特性

cues.en: is that the combination
cues.zh: 这就是那个组合吗

cues.en: of an index and a term
cues.zh: 一个索引和一个词项

cues.en: uniquely identifies a log entry.
cues.zh: 唯一标识一条日志条目。

cues.en: That is, if two log entries
cues.zh: 也就是说，如果两条日志条目

cues.en: are in the same index, log index position,
cues.zh: 都处在相同的索引，也就是日志索引位置上，

cues.en: and they have the same term,
cues.zh: 它们有相同的术语，

cues.en: then it's guaranteed that they will also have the same command.
cues.zh: 那么就可以保证它们也会有相同的命令。

cues.en: And furthermore,
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: it's also guaranteed that if two entries have this property, then all preceding entries
cues.zh: 同样可以保证，如果两个条目具有这个性质，那么所有前面的条目

cues.en: in those logs will also match each other.
cues.zh: 在那些日志中也会相互匹配。

cues.en: So the combination of a term and an index
cues.zh: 所以，就是项和索引的组合

cues.en: uniquely identifies
cues.zh: 唯一标识

cues.en: an entire log from its beginning up to that point.
cues.zh: 从开始到那个时间点的完整日志。

cues.en: Furthermore, it turns out that if a particular entry is committed,
cues.zh: 而且，事实证明，如果某个特定条目已提交，

cues.en: then all preceding entries are also committed.
cues.zh: 那么之前的所有条目也都已提交。

cues.en: And that kind of follows from the previous rule, in that you can see if a majority of the servers store this one entry here at index five,
cues.zh: 这其实也延续了上一条规则，你可以看看大多数服务器是否都在索引5处存储了这一条目，

cues.en: then because of the the rule above, they must also store all the same earlier entries, and so we know all of those entries will also exist on a majority of the servers.

cues.zh: S4 也成不了 Leader，因为它拿不到其他任何节点的选票，尽管最后任期相同，但 S4 的日志太短了。所以我们知道，只有前三台服务器中的一台能当选 Leader。

cues.en: In fact, if s one is in the mix, s one is guaranteed to win the election. But s two or s three could win by getting votes from each other and then one of server four or five. But in any case, you can see that the leader for the next term must contain that log entry.
cues.zh: 事实上，如果有 S1 参选，S1 必定会赢得选举。但 S2 或 S3 也可以通过互投再加上服务器 4 或 5 的选票获胜。但无论如何，下一任期的 Leader 都必须包含那条日志条目。

cues.en: Now let's consider the second case where a leader is trying to commit an entry that was initially started in an earlier term.
cues.zh: 现在我们来看第二种情况：Leader 试图提交一个最初在前序任期生成的条目。

cues.en: In this situation,
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，

cues.en: the leader for term two replicated an entry on only two machines before its term ended.
cues.zh: 任期 2 的 Leader 在其任期结束前，只把条目复制到了两台机器上。

cues.en: And then the leader for term three, for some reason, was not aware of those entries,
cues.zh: 随后任期 3 的 Leader 出于某种原因并不知道这些条目，

cues.en: created a bunch of entries of its own and then crashed.
cues.zh: 它自己创建了一堆条目，然后就崩溃了。

cues.en: And now we're back, another machine has been elected leader in term four. And finally, it's trying to make all of the other servers logs match its own.
cues.zh: 现在我们回来了，另一台机器在第四任期被选为领导者。最后，它试图让所有其他服务器的日志与自己的匹配。

cues.en: And so it replicates
cues.zh: 于是它复制

cues.en: this entry from
cues.zh: 这条来自

cues.en: that old entry from term two over onto server three. And now at this point,
cues.zh: 第二任期的旧条目到服务器三上。现在到了这一步，

cues.en: that entry is known by the leader to be stored on a majority of servers.
cues.zh: 领导者知道该条目已存储在多数服务器上。

cues.en: But
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: that entry is not safely committed. And the reason you can see this is that if the leader were to crash now and a new leader were to be elected,
cues.zh: 该条目并未安全提交。你能看出这一点的原因是，如果领导者现在崩溃并且选出新的领导者，

cues.en: it's possible
cues.zh: 有可能

cues.en: that server five could be elected
cues.zh: 服务器五会被选中

cues.en: using any majority that doesn't include server one. It could get votes from server four, server three, or server two since its last term is greater than any of those machines.
cues.zh: 利用任何不包含服务器一的多数派。它可以从服务器四、服务器三或服务器二获得选票，因为它的最后任期比那些机器都大。

cues.en: And if it's elected, then it's gonna try and propagate its log, meaning it'll write those entries from term three across all of the other servers and all of these entries will go away.
cues.zh: 如果它当选，就会试图传播自己的日志，也就是把第三任期的那些条目写到所有其他服务器上，所有这些条目都会被覆盖掉。

cues.en: So we cannot
cues.zh: 所以我们不能

cues.en: consider
cues.zh: 认为

cues.en: entry three to be committed at this point. It's simply not safe.
cues.zh: 条目三此时已提交。这根本不安全。

cues.en: In this situation, the new rules for elections are not enough by themselves to guarantee safety.
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，新的选举规则本身不足以保证安全。

cues.en: We also have to modify the rules for commitment.
cues.zh: 我们还必须修改提交规则。

cues.en: Remember, up until now,
cues.zh: 记住，到目前为止，

cues.en: a leader could decide that an entry was committed as soon as it saw that the entry was stored on a majority of the servers.
cues.zh: 领导者只要看到条目存储在多数服务器上，就可以判定该条目已提交。

cues.en: But in order to guarantee safety, we have to add another rule, which is that in addition,
cues.zh: 但为了保证安全，我们必须再加一条规则，即此外，

cues.en: the leader must be able to see that at least one of the entries from its term, from the current term,
cues.zh: 领导者必须能看到至少一条来自其任期、来自当前任期的条目

cues.en: is also stored on a majority of servers.
cues.zh: 也存储在多数服务器上。

cues.en: So going back to our example,
cues.zh: 回到我们的例子，

cues.en: if the leader
cues.zh: 如果领导者

cues.en: finishes replicating entry three to a majority, it can't yet commit that entry and pass it to the state machines.
cues.zh: 已经把条目三复制到多数节点，它还不能提交该条目并传给状态机。

cues.en: Instead, it has to also wait until the first entry
cues.zh: 相反，它还必须等到第一个条目

cues.en: from its term
cues.zh: 来自其任期

cues.en: gets committed, that is stored on a majority of the machines. And now at this point, both of those entries can be passed to state machines. They're safe. And the reason that for that is that we can see that now there's no way Server 5 can get elected leader for the next term. And the reason is that there's too many other servers out there with more recent terms in their logs. The only vote Server 5 would be able to get is Server 4.
cues.zh: 被提交，也就是存储在多数机器上。此时，这两个条目都可以传给状态机了。它们是安全的。原因在于，现在 Server 5 无法在下一任期当选领导者。因为其他太多服务器的日志里有更新的任期。Server 5 唯一能拿到的票是 Server 4 的。

cues.en: So at this point, both entries three and four are safe.
cues.zh: 所以此时，条目三和条目四都是安全的。

cues.en: So with the combination of the new election rules where we compare logs,
cues.zh: 因此，结合比较日志的新选举规则，

cues.en: and this new commitment rule, we can guarantee that the raft safety property always holds. That is, once a leader's decided an entry is committed, it will be present in the log of every leader in the future. Well, okay, actually, I've only shown you that the log entry will be present in the leader for the very next term, but it's also fairly straightforward to prove that every future leader will also have the log entry. I'm not going to go through that proof.
cues.zh: 以及这个新的提交规则，我们就能保证 Raft 的安全性始终成立。也就是说，一旦领导者决定某个条目已提交，它就会出现在未来每个领导者的日志中。好吧，其实我只向你展示了该日志条目会出现在下一个任期的领导者中，但也很容易证明未来每个领导者都会有该日志条目。我就不展开这个证明了。

cues.en: And then once we know the raft safety property holds, then as I mentioned on the previous slide, we know that the overall replicated log will also be safe.
cues.zh: 然后，一旦我们知道 Raft 的安全性成立，那么正如我在上一页幻灯片中提到的，我们知道整体复制日志也是安全的。

cues.en: Now that we've guaranteed safety and we know that the leader's log is correct,
cues.zh: 既然已经保证了安全性，并且我们知道领导者的日志是正确的，

cues.en: how do we make all of the followers' logs match the leader's log? Well, first, let me show you the different ways in which logs can be inconsistent. This slide illustrates
cues.zh: 我们怎么让所有 follower 的日志都与 leader 的日志一致？首先，我给大家展示日志可能不一致的几种情况。这张幻灯片说明了

cues.en: what can happen.
cues.zh: 可能会发生什么。

cues.en: It's possible that followers can be missing entries that the leader has, such as in this case for followers a and b here,
cues.zh: 跟随者可能会缺少领导者已有的条目，比如这里的跟随者 a 和 b 这种情况，

cues.en: or also for follower e.
cues.zh: 或者对跟随者 e 也是如此。

cues.en: And followers
cues.zh: 还有关注者

cues.en: and followers can also have extraneous entries not present on the leader,
cues.zh: 而跟随者也可能有领导者上不存在的多余条目，

cues.en: such as these entries for term seven over here, the entries for terms two and three at the bottom, an extra entry
cues.zh: 比如这边第七项的这些条目、底部第二项和第三项的条目，以及一个额外条目

cues.en: for term six,
cues.zh: 至于第六项，

cues.en: and so on.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: So what we have to do is get rid of all the extraneous entries from the follower logs, and then fill in all of the missing entries
cues.zh: 所以我们要做的是清除关注者日志中所有多余的条目，然后补全所有缺失的条目。

cues.en: from the leader's log.
cues.zh: 摘自领导者的日志。

cues.en: To restore log consistency,
cues.zh: 为了恢复日志的一致性，

cues.en: the leader maintains a state variable for each of the followers in the cluster, which I will call next index. And this is the index in the log of the next log entry that the server intends to send to that follower.
cues.zh: 领导者为集群中的每个跟随者维护一个状态变量，我称之为 next index。这个变量是该服务器打算发送给该跟随者的下一条日志条目在日志中的索引。

cues.en: Initially, when the server becomes leader, it sets these next index values to the entry just after the last one in its log.
cues.zh: 最初，当服务器成为领导者时，它会将这些下一个索引值设置为其日志中最后一条之后的条目。

cues.en: So in this example where we have a new leader for term seven and the last entry in the log is index 10, it will set next index to 11 for all of the client, all of the followers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 所以在这个例子中，term 7 有了新的领导者，并且日志中最后一条记录的索引是 10，它会为集群中所有的客户端、所有的跟随者将 next index 设为 11。

cues.en: The leader will find out about consistency issues through the append entries RPC.
cues.zh: leader 会通过 append entries RPC 发现一致性问题。

cues.en: Remember, there's this consistency check performed by followers whenever they receive an append entries request,
cues.zh: 记住，follower 在收到 append entries 请求时都会执行这个一致性检查，

cues.en: and that will find any problems.
cues.zh: 这就能发现任何问题。

cues.en: So the next time this leader attempts to communicate with either of those followers,
cues.zh: 所以下次 leader 尝试与这两个 follower 中的任意一个通信时，

cues.en: it's going to include
cues.zh: 它会带上

cues.en: the index
cues.zh: next index 前一条日志的

cues.en: and the term
cues.zh: 索引

cues.en: ten and six for the entry just before next index as part of that request. By the way, the next request is probably going to be a heartbeat that it sends out as soon as it becomes elected leader. But heartbeats behave just like all other append entries except that they have no new values,
cues.zh: 和任期号，也就是十和六，作为请求的一部分。顺便说一下，下一个请求很可能是一个心跳，它一旦当选 leader 就会立刻发出。但心跳除了不携带新值之外，行为和其他所有 append entries 完全一样，

cues.en: but they still include the consistency check.
cues.zh: 不过它仍然包含一致性检查。

cues.en: So when this message arrives at follower a, it's going to compare this term index with its own log, and it has no matching entry there. So it's going to reject
cues.zh: 所以当这条消息到达 follower A 时，它会拿这个任期号和索引与自己的日志比较，发现没有匹配的条目。于是它会拒绝

cues.en: the append entries request.
cues.zh: 这个 append entries 请求。

cues.en: When the server sees this rejection, sorry, when the leader sees this rejection,
cues.zh: 当服务器看到这个拒绝时，抱歉，当 leader 看到这个拒绝时，

cues.en: its response is very simple. It just reduces next index by one. So it will drop index back to 10,
cues.zh: 它的反应非常简单。它只是把 next index 减一。于是索引会退回到 10，

cues.en: and then we'll try again. This time you can see the server will include information about index nine, and that check is going to fail, and this will keep failing over and over and over and over again until eventually
cues.zh: 然后我们再次尝试。这次你可以看到服务器会带上索引九的信息，而那个检查会失败，这样会一次又一次地失败，直到最终

cues.en: next index becomes five
cues.zh: 对于 follower A，next index 变成五

cues.en: for follower A.
At this point now,
cues.zh: 到这里，

cues.en: the leader
cues.zh: 领导者

cues.en: will include information about
cues.zh: 会在请求中包含

cues.en: log entry four in the request, and that will now match.
cues.zh: 日志条目四的信息，这样就能匹配上了。

cues.en: And so once that matches, then the follower can add the entry for four, and the leader will eventually fill in its log.
cues.zh: 一旦匹配成功，跟随者就可以添加第四条条目，领导者最终也会补全它的日志。

cues.en: A similar thing will happen for follower B. Again,
cues.zh: 跟随者 B 也会发生类似的情况。同样，

cues.en: when next index is 11, the consistency check will fail. In this case, we'll back up again, and again, and again, and again,
cues.zh: 当 next index 为 11 时，一致性检查会失败。这种情况下，我们会再次回退，一次又一次，

cues.en: and again, the way back, until eventually next index becomes four,
cues.zh: 不断回退，直到 next index 最终变成四，

cues.en: And the consistency information is for the preceding entry, log index three with term one, and that will match, and then eventually this log will also fill in.
cues.zh: 而一致性信息是针对前一条条目的，即日志索引三、任期一，这样就能匹配上，最终这个日志也会补全。

cues.en: One other note about this process of making the logs consistent.
cues.zh: 关于让日志保持一致的这个过程，还有一点要说明。

cues.en: Whenever a follower
cues.zh: 每当跟随者

cues.en: receives an entry for its log that is replacing another entry that's inconsistent,
cues.zh: 收到一条要替换其日志中另一条不一致条目的条目时，

cues.en: then it truncates its log, removing all of the entries after that.
cues.zh: 它就会截断自己的日志，删除那之后的所有条目。

cues.en: So for example,
cues.zh: 举个例子，

cues.en: in this case, if the leader
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，如果领导者

cues.en: sends the entry for slot four
cues.zh: 把槽位四的条目

cues.en: to this follower, and it already had a conflicting entry two in there, then
cues.zh: 发送给这个跟随者，而它那里已经有一条冲突的条目二，那么

cues.en: not only will it overwrite the entry for two, for that, the old contents of that slot, but it'll remove all of the remaining ones after that. We know any entry after an extraneous entry is also extraneous.
cues.zh: 它不仅会覆盖该槽位的旧内容，也就是条目二，还会删除之后所有剩余的条目。我们知道，多余条目之后的任何条目也都是多余的。

cues.en: Let me just summarize quickly what I've covered in this section of the presentation on leader changes.
cues.zh: 让我快速总结一下我在本次演示这一部分关于领导者变更所讲的内容。

cues.en: There are two overall problems we have to deal with. One is ensuring the safety of the system, which has to do with how we choose leaders and when we decide log entries are committed. And then second, once a new leader comes to power, all it has to do is make the followers' logs match its own. And the append entries consistency check provides all the information we need in order to do that.
cues.zh: 我们要处理两个总体问题。一是确保系统安全，这关系到如何选择领导者以及何时认定日志条目已提交。其次，一旦新领导者上位，它只需让跟随者的日志与自己的保持一致。而追加条目一致性检查提供了我们实现这一点所需的全部信息。

cues.en: The fourth step of the RAFT protocol
cues.zh: RAFT 协议的第四步

cues.en: is another issue related to leader changeovers,
cues.zh: 是另一个与领导者更替相关的问题，

cues.en: which is that an old leader may not actually be dead.
cues.zh: 即旧领导者可能实际上并未死亡。

cues.en: For example,
cues.zh: 例如，

cues.en: suppose that there is a network partition
cues.zh: 假设存在一个网络分区

cues.en: that separates the leader from the rest of the cluster. Well, the rest of the cluster could then
cues.zh: 将领导者与集群其余部分隔开。那么集群其余部分就可能

cues.en: elect a new leader, they'll wait the election time out and run an election, elect a new leader.
cues.zh: 选举出新领导者，它们会等到选举超时后发起选举，选出新领导者。

cues.en: Now the problem is what if that old leader becomes reconnected again?
cues.zh: 现在的问题是，如果那个旧领导者重新连接上会怎样？

cues.en: It does not know about the election, does not know about the new leader,
cues.zh: 它不知道这次选举，不知道有新领导者，

cues.en: and so it will attempt to behave as a leader such as trying to replicate log entries. And in fact, there could be clients that are talking to that old leader, sending it requests, and the leader will receive them and record them in its own log, and then attempt to replicate them on other machines in the cluster.
cues.zh: 于是它会试图以领导者身份行事，比如尝试复制日志条目。事实上，可能有客户端正在与那个旧领导者通信，向它发送请求，旧领导者会接收这些请求并记录到自己的日志中，然后尝试把它们复制到集群中的其他机器上。

cues.en: But we have to stop that from happening. And the way we do that is with the use of terms.
cues.zh: 但我们必须阻止这种情况发生。我们采用的方式是使用任期（terms）。

cues.en: What happens is that every RPC
cues.zh: 每条 RPC 都会

cues.en: includes
cues.zh: 包含

cues.en: the sender's term.
cues.zh: 发送方的任期。

cues.en: And when the RPC is received,
cues.zh: 当收到 RPC 时，

cues.en: the receiver compares that to its own term.
cues.zh: 接收方会将其与自己的任期进行比较。

cues.en: And if they don't match, then whichever one is out of date will update. So for example, if the sender's term is older than the receiver's, that means the sender is stale.
cues.zh: 如果不匹配，那么过时的一方就会更新。举例来说，如果发送方的任期比接收方的旧，说明发送方已过期。

cues.en: When this happens, the receiver
cues.zh: 这时，接收方

cues.en: immediately rejects the remote procedure call, does not execute it,
cues.zh: 会立即拒绝这个远程过程调用，不执行它，

cues.en: and sends a response back
cues.zh: 并返回一个响应

cues.en: to the sender that includes the receiver's
cues.zh: 给发送方，其中包含接收方的

cues.en: term.
cues.zh: 任期。

cues.en: The sender sees that, realizes that its term is out of date, and so then it steps down. That is, it becomes a follower again, and at the same time, it updates its term. So now it's up to date, it's consistent with the other server.
cues.zh: 发送方看到后，意识到自己的任期已过时，于是降级。也就是说，它重新变成跟随者，同时更新自己的任期。现在它就最新了，与其他服务器一致了。

cues.en: Conversely,
cues.zh: 反过来，

cues.en: if the receiver's term is older,
cues.zh: 如果接收方的任期更旧，

cues.en: then the receiver also steps down if it wasn't already a follower.
cues.zh: 那么接收方如果还不是跟随者，也会降级。

cues.en: It updates its term to match, but then the receiver will go ahead and still handle the RPC. It doesn't reject the RPC, there's no need for that. It just becomes a follower and does what the RPC says.
cues.zh: 它更新自己的任期以匹配，但随后接收方仍会继续处理这个 RPC。它不会拒绝 RPC，没必要这么做。它只是变成跟随者，并执行 RPC 的要求。

cues.en: Now the interesting thing here is that the election process
cues.zh: 有意思的是，选举过程

cues.en: causes term updates.
cues.zh: 会导致任期更新。

cues.en: That is when a candidate requests votes
cues.zh: 也就是当候选人请求投票时，

cues.en: and it has to talk to a majority of the servers to do that, it will include the term for its candidacy in those RPCs.
cues.zh: 它需要与多数服务器通信才能做到，它会在这些 RPC 中包含自己参选的任期。

cues.en: And so all of those recipients will update their terms to match that of the candidate.
cues.zh: 于是所有接收方都会更新自己的任期，以匹配该候选人的任期。

cues.en: And so as a result, by the time a new leader is elected, a majority of the servers in the cluster reflect that new term.
cues.zh: 因此，等到选出新领导者时，集群中大多数服务器都已反映出新的任期。

cues.en: That means that once this election is complete, there's no way that that deposed server can actually receive a new log entry and write it to a majority of the cluster. Because to do that, it would have to contact
cues.zh: 这意味着，一旦这次选举完成，被罢免的服务器就无法再接收新的日志条目并将其写入集群中的大多数服务器。因为要做到这一点，它必须联系

cues.en: at least one of those servers
cues.zh: 至少其中一台

cues.en: that has the new term. And when it does that, the term mismatch will be discovered and that old leader will then step down.
cues.zh: 拥有新任期的服务器。而一旦它这么做，任期不匹配就会被发现，旧领导者随即下台。

cues.en: So this is the key idea. There's a few other corner cases here that I'm not going to talk about, but
cues.zh: 这就是核心思路。这里还有一些其他边缘情况我不打算讨论，但

cues.en: the term notion allows us to handle all of those. That if there's something out of date, the terms detect that.
cues.zh: 任期这个概念让我们能够处理所有这些情况。如果有任何过时的东西，任期机制能检测到。

cues.en: Now let's move on to the fifth part of the RAFT protocol. This is how do clients interact with the system.
cues.zh: 现在我们进入 RAFT 协议的第五部分。也就是客户端如何与系统交互。

cues.en: This is mostly pretty simple.
cues.zh: 这部分基本上相当简单。

cues.en: The client just sends their commands to the leader machine and they get responses back.
cues.zh: 客户端只需把命令发送给领导者机器，然后收到响应。

cues.en: Now, if the client doesn't know who is the leader, that's fine. It can talk to any server in the cluster.
cues.zh: 如果客户端不知道谁是领导者，也没关系。它可以和集群中任意一台服务器通信。

cues.en: And if that server is not the leader, then it will tell the client who the leader is and the client can retry with the leader.
cues.zh: 如果那台服务器不是领导者，它会告诉客户端领导者是谁，客户端就可以向领导者重试。

cues.en: So that's easy. As I have mentioned before, the leader does not respond to the client
cues.zh: 所以这很简单。正如我之前提到的，领导者不会立即响应客户端

cues.en: until the command has been logged,
cues.zh: 直到命令被记录，

cues.en: and most importantly, committed, so we know it's on a majority of the server's disks,
cues.zh: 最重要的是，被提交，这样我们就知道它已在大多数服务器的磁盘上，

cues.en: and then executed by the leader's state machine.
cues.zh: 然后由领导者的状态机执行。

cues.en: So at that point, the leader returns the result back to the client.
cues.zh: 这时，领导者把结果返回给客户端。

cues.en: The only tricky thing in here is what happens if the leader crashes or if the request otherwise times out?
cues.zh: 这里唯一棘手的情况是：如果领导者崩溃了，或者请求超时了，会怎样？

cues.en: And the answer is that when that happens, the client simply reissues the command. In fact, they can just pick a random server when that happens. Assume the leader's crashed, try some other server.
cues.zh: 答案是：发生这种情况时，客户端只需重新发送命令。事实上，它甚至可以随便挑一个服务器。假设领导者崩溃了，就换另一个服务器试试。

cues.en: And eventually,
cues.zh: 最终，

cues.en: it will find its way to cluster's new leader.
cues.zh: 它会找到集群的新领导者。

cues.en: And then it will retry that request and the new leader will execute it and the command will be carried out.
cues.zh: 然后它会重试那个请求，新领导者会执行它，命令就完成了。

cues.en: So this guarantees
cues.zh: 这就保证了

cues.en: that a command will eventually be executed.
cues.zh: 命令最终一定会被执行。

cues.en: However, this leaves open the risk that a command might get executed twice.
cues.zh: 然而，这也带来了命令可能被执行两次的风险。

cues.en: The problem is that the leader might crash
cues.zh: 问题在于，领导者可能在执行完命令之后、

cues.en: after it's executed a command, but before it has responded to the client.
cues.zh: 但在向客户端返回响应之前崩溃。

cues.en: So the client won't know that the command has actually been logged and executed.
cues.zh: 这样客户端就不知道命令实际上已经被记录并执行了。

cues.en: If this happens, the client will then turn around and reassure that command to the next leader that it can find, and we run the risk that the command couldn't get executed twice. That's not acceptable. We want each command execute once and exactly once.
cues.zh: 如果发生这种情况，客户端就会转而把这条命令重新发给它能找到的下一个领导者，于是命令就有可能被执行两次。这是不可接受的。我们希望每条命令执行一次，且仅执行一次。

cues.en: The way Raft achieves that is that the client generates a unique identifier for every command
cues.zh: Raft 实现这一点的方式是：客户端为每条命令生成一个唯一标识符，

cues.en: and it embeds that in the command that it sends to the leader.
cues.zh: 并把它嵌入发送给领导者的命令中。

cues.en: When the leader logs that command,
cues.zh: 当领导者记录这条命令时，

cues.en: it includes this ID in the log entry.
cues.zh: 会把该 ID 包含在日志条目里。

cues.en: But before the leader accepts a command,
cues.zh: 但在领导者接受命令之前，

cues.en: it first checks to see if it already has that identifier
cues.zh: 它会先检查自己的日志中其他条目

cues.en: in some other entry in its log. And if so, then it knows it's receiving a redundant command.
cues.zh: 是否已经存在这个标识符。如果是，那它就知道收到了一条冗余命令。

cues.en: So if it finds the ID in the log, then it ignores that new command, and instead it waits for the old command to be executed by the state machine, if it hasn't already been executed,
cues.zh: 所以如果在日志中找到了这个 ID，它就忽略这条新命令，转而等待状态机执行那条旧命令——如果还没执行过的话，

cues.en: and then it returns that old response.
cues.zh: 然后返回那个旧的响应。

cues.en: So as a result, we get exactly once semantics.
cues.zh: 这样一来，我们就得到了恰好一次的语义。

cues.en: Each command is executed exactly once. And this is a key element of what's called linearizability,
cues.zh: 每条命令都恰好执行一次。这是所谓线性一致性的关键要素，

cues.en: a particular form of strong semantics that we like for systems to have.
cues.zh: 也是我们希望系统具备的一种特定的强一致性语义。

cues.en: This brings us to the last of the six parts of the RAFT protocol.
cues.zh: 这就引出了 RAFT 协议六个部分的最后一部分。

cues.en: We need to have some mechanism for changing the system configuration over time. And when I say system configuration,
cues.zh: 我们需要某种机制来随时间变更系统配置。说到系统配置，

cues.en: what I mean is information about the servers that are part of the cluster. So that consists of the ID of each server and a network address that can be used to communicate with us... With it. This information is really crucial because it's what determines what we need to do in order to get a majority vote for things like electing a leader or committing a log entry.
cues.zh: 我指的是关于集群中各个服务器的信息。它包括每个服务器的 ID，以及一个可用于与它通信的网络地址。这些信息至关重要，因为它决定了我们要怎样做才能获得多数票，比如选举领导者或提交日志条目。

cues.en: Now the reason we have to support changes in this is because, for example, machines will fail and so they'll need to be replaced with new machines,
cues.zh: 我们之所以必须支持配置变更，是因为比如机器会故障，需要换上新机器，

cues.en: or the people managing a cluster might want to change the degree of replication in the cluster. And we'd like to be able to do this in an automatic and safe fashion without bringing the system down in order to change the configuration.
cues.zh: 或者集群管理者可能想改变集群的副本数量。我们希望能以自动且安全的方式完成这些变更，而不必为了改配置而让系统停机。

cues.en: Now it's important to realize that we can't just switch directly from an old configuration to a new configuration.
cues.zh: 首先需要明确的是，我们不能直接从旧配置切换到新配置。

cues.en: And to see that, let's look at the example at the bottom of this slide.
cues.zh: 为了说明这点，我们来看幻灯片底部的例子。

cues.en: Suppose the system is running in a configuration where there are three servers,
cues.zh: 假设系统当前运行在三台服务器的配置下，

cues.en: and then we want to add two more servers
cues.zh: 然后我们想再增加两台服务器，

cues.en: so that afterwards there will be five servers in the cluster.
cues.zh: 这样集群之后就会有五台服务器。

cues.en: If we just ask each server to change configuration from that old configuration
cues.zh: 如果我们直接让每台服务器把配置从旧的

cues.en: to the new one, the problem is that they couldn't do it at exactly the same time.
cues.zh: 切换到新的，问题就在于它们不可能在完全相同的时刻完成切换。

cues.en: The changes would be spaced out at least slightly in time.
cues.zh: 切换在时间上至少会有些许先后差异。

cues.en: And the problem with this is this could result in conflicting majorities.
cues.zh: 这带来的问题是，可能会产生冲突的多数派。

cues.en: For example, there's a point in time where servers one and two
cues.zh: 例如，在某个时间点，服务器 1 和 2

cues.en: could get together to form a majority
cues.zh: 可以联合起来，构成

cues.en: of the old cluster.
cues.zh: 旧集群的多数派。

cues.en: And they could make decisions based on that, such as electing a leader and committing entries to a particular slot in the log.
cues.zh: 它们就可以据此做出决策，比如选出一个 Leader，或者把条目提交到日志的某个特定位置。

cues.en: But at the same point in time, the other three servers have switched to
cues.zh: 但在同一时刻，另外三台服务器已经切换到了

cues.en: configuration, and they form a majority of that configuration. So it's possible they could get together
cues.zh: 新配置，而且构成了新配置的多数派。所以它们也有可能联合起来，

cues.en: with their majority
cues.zh: 凭借它们的多数派，

cues.en: and commit
cues.zh: 去提交

cues.en: an entry for the same log entry that conflicts with the one, committed by the first two servers.
cues.zh: 一条与前两台服务器提交相冲突的日志条目。

cues.en: What this says is that we have to use a two phase protocol. We can't do things in one phase. And, of course, that's typical of any kind of distributed decision making. If anybody ever tells you that they think they can make a distributed decision in a single phase,
cues.zh: 这说明我们必须使用两阶段协议，无法一步搞定。当然，这也是任何分布式决策的典型特征。如果有人告诉你他能在单阶段内完成分布式决策，

cues.en: you should question them pretty seriously. Because either they're wrong or they've discovered something that everybody else in the world doesn't know yet.
cues.zh: 你就得认真质疑他一下了。因为他要么搞错了，要么就是发现了全世界其他人都还不知道的新东西。

cues.en: The solution is to use two phases to change the configuration.
cues.zh: 解决办法是用两个阶段来变更配置。

cues.en: RAFT switches first to an intermediate phase called joint consensus.
cues.zh: RAFT 会先切换到一个名为联合共识的中间阶段。

cues.en: During this phase, the cluster consists of all of the servers in both the new and the old configurations, so the union of those configurations.
cues.zh: 在这个阶段，集群由新配置和旧配置中的所有服务器组成，也就是这两个配置的并集。

cues.en: But decisions such as elections and commitment require a separate majority, separate agreement from both the old configuration
cues.zh: 但选举和提交这类决策需要单独的多数派，需要旧配置和新配置分别达成一致

cues.en: and the new configuration.
cues.zh: 和新配置。

cues.en: Let me show you how this works.
cues.zh: 我来演示一下这是怎么运作的。

cues.en: So we start off
cues.zh: 我们从

cues.en: in an existing configuration I'll call c old on the slide.
cues.zh: 一个现有配置开始，我在幻灯片上称它为 c old。

cues.en: And the way a configuration change is initiated is that a client makes a request of the leader just like it would for any other state machine operation.
cues.zh: 发起配置变更的方式是，客户端向领导者发出请求，就像它对任何其他状态机操作所做的那样。

cues.en: When the server receives that request, then the leader adds an entry to its log describing this joint configuration,
cues.zh: 当服务器收到该请求后，领导者会在其日志中添加一条描述这个联合配置的条目，

cues.en: which I'll call c old plus new.
cues.zh: 我称它为 c old plus new。

cues.en: That's just a log entry like any other log entry. The server puts it in its log, and then the leader propagates it out to the other servers in the cluster using the append entries RPC,
cues.zh: 它就像任何其他日志条目一样。服务器把它放进日志，然后领导者用追加条目 RPC 将它传播到集群中的其他服务器，

cues.en: just like any other log entry.
cues.zh: 就像任何其他日志条目一样。

cues.en: The only thing different about configuration
cues.zh: 配置变更唯一不同的一点

cues.en: changes
cues.zh: 是

cues.en: is that they take effect immediately.
cues.zh: 它们会立即生效。

cues.en: So as soon as a server places a new configuration into its log, it begins living by that configuration entry. It doesn't wait for the configuration entry,
cues.zh: 所以一旦服务器把新配置放入日志，它就开始按该配置条目运作。它不会像处理普通日志条目那样，等待配置条目

cues.en: for the log entry to become committed before applying it like it would for normal log entries.
cues.zh: 也就是日志条目被提交后再应用。

cues.en: So back to our timeline here, the leader places the new configuration entry in its log.
cues.zh: 回到我们这里的时序图，Leader 将新配置条目写入自己的日志中。

cues.en: And then as far as that leader's concerned, that's the configuration in effect. So that leader makes all of its decisions
cues.zh: 在该 Leader 看来，这个配置就已经生效了。因此它做的所有决策

cues.en: according to the old plus new configuration.
cues.zh: 都会遵循新旧联合配置。

cues.en: That means that, for example,
cues.zh: 这意味着，举例来说，

cues.en: for any log entry to be committed, it must be logged
cues.zh: 任何日志条目若要被提交，都必须被记录

cues.en: on a majority of the machines in the old cluster and a majority of machines in the new configuration.
cues.zh: 在旧集群的大多数机器，以及新配置的大多数机器上。

cues.en: Now for a while, until that entry becomes replicated or reaches a point of being committed,
cues.zh: 在此期间，在该条目完成复制或达到提交状态之前，

cues.en: it's possible that decisions might be made either with c old or c old plus new. For example, if the leader crashes shortly after logging the new configuration entry, it's possible
cues.zh: 系统可能依据 C_old 做出决策，也可能依据 C_old+new。例如，如果 Leader 在写入新配置条目后不久就宕机了，

cues.en: that some other machine
cues.zh: 就有可能

cues.en: that is still operating under the old configuration could be elected and take over the cluster.
cues.zh: 另一台仍按旧配置运行的机器被选为 Leader，并接管集群。

cues.en: But at some point,
cues.zh: 但到了某个时刻，

cues.en: this new configuration entry will become committed, c old plus new.
cues.zh: 这个 C_old+new 的新配置条目最终会被提交。

cues.en: Once that happens now,
cues.zh: 一旦它被提交，

cues.en: it's not possible for any machine to make a decision based purely on c old.
cues.zh: 任何机器就都不可能再单纯基于 C_old 来做决策了。

cues.en: Now the way to see this is to realize
cues.zh: 理解这一点的关键在于：

cues.en: that in order for a leader to become elected,
cues.zh: 一个节点要想当选为 Leader，

cues.en: it must hold in its log all of the entries that have been committed so far. So once this see old plus new entry has been committed,
cues.zh: 其日志中必须包含迄今为止所有已提交的条目。所以一旦这条 C_old+new 条目被提交，

cues.en: it's guaranteed that any leader that's elected will have that in its log, and that means that leader will be living by it. So for example, the decision about whether it won the election will be made based on c old plus new, and any log entries that it commits will also be committed based on c old plus new.
cues.zh: 就能保证随后当选的任何 Leader 的日志中都会包含它，这意味着该 Leader 必须遵循它。例如，它是否赢得选举将基于 C_old+new 来判定，它提交的任何日志条目也都会基于 C_old+new 来提交。

cues.en: So at this point, it's no longer possible for any server in the cluster to make decisions based purely on the old configuration.
cues.zh: 所以此时，集群中任何服务器都不可能仅凭旧配置做决策。

cues.en: So this, at this point now, the cluster is operating under the joint consensus.
cues.zh: 所以现在这个时候，集群是在联合共识下运行的。

cues.en: As soon as that joint consensus has become committed,
cues.zh: 一旦联合共识达成提交，

cues.en: the leader can now begin propagating
cues.zh: 领导者就可以开始传播

cues.en: a configuration change entry for cnew. So again, it puts that in its log, and it begins replicating that out to the cluster. And again, for a period of time,
cues.zh: cnew 的配置变更条目。同样，它把该条目放入日志，并开始向集群复制。同样，会有一段时间，

cues.en: it's possible
cues.zh: 有可能

cues.en: that the cluster may operate under either c new or under that joint consensus.
cues.zh: 集群会在 cnew 或联合共识下运行。

cues.en: Because once again, that server could crash and another server could take over that's using the joint consensus.
cues.zh: 因为再次强调，那台服务器可能崩溃，另一台使用联合共识的服务器可能接管。

cues.en: But again, eventually,
cues.zh: 但同样，最终，

cues.en: that new configuration entry will become committed. And then once that happens, all future decisions in the cluster will be based on c new.
cues.zh: 新的配置条目会达成提交。一旦发生，集群中所有未来的决策都将基于 cnew。

cues.en: So the key idea here, the key thing you can see is that there's no point in time
cues.zh: 所以这里的关键思想、你能看到的关键点是，不存在某个时间点

cues.en: when both c old and c new can make decisions without consulting the other.
cues.zh: cold 和 cnew 都能在不咨询对方的情况下做决策。

cues.en: There's a period of time where c old can make unilateral decisions, and a period of time where c new can make decisions,
cues.zh: 有一段时间 cold 可以单方面做决策，也有一段时间 cnew 可以做决策，

cues.en: but those do not overlap, guaranteed not to overlap.
cues.zh: 但这两段时间不重叠，保证不重叠。

cues.en: And in between,
cues.zh: 而在中间，

cues.en: both configurations must be consulted.
cues.zh: 必须同时咨询两种配置。

cues.en: So this guarantees that we can't ever have two separate consensuses
cues.zh: 所以这保证了我们不可能在集群中

cues.en: form in the cluster at one time.
cues.zh: 同时形成两个独立的共识。

cues.en: By the way, this two phase nature is fundamental.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这种两阶段特性是根本性的。

cues.en: So any
cues.zh: 所以任何

cues.en: consensus algorithm will have to use two phases of some sort to change configuration.
cues.zh: 共识算法在更改配置时都必须使用某种两阶段过程。

cues.en: In fact, any sort of distributed agreement requires two phases. If anybody comes to you with a distributed agreement algorithm and they claim it works in a single phase, you should be very skeptical because either they're mistaken or they've discovered something really important and new that none of the rest of us know.
cues.zh: 事实上，任何形式的分布式协商都需要两个阶段。如果有人拿着分布式协商算法来找你，声称它能在单阶段内工作，你应该高度怀疑，因为他们要么搞错了，要么发现了我们其他人都不了解的重大新成果。

cues.en: There are a couple of other details of this protocol.
cues.zh: 这个协议还有其他几个细节。

cues.en: First, while we're in transition, it's possible that a server from either configuration can serve as the leader for the cluster.
cues.zh: 首先，在过渡期间，来自任一配置的服务器都可能成为集群的领导者。

cues.en: Now this one tricky thing, which is what if the current leader is not in the new configuration?
cues.zh: 这里有个棘手的情况：如果当前领导者不在新配置中怎么办？

cues.en: Then eventually,
cues.zh: 那么最终，

cues.en: it has to step down. It can't continue serving as leader forever in a cluster where it's not the... Not part of the configuration.
cues.zh: 它必须下台。在一个它不属于配置的集群里，它不能永远继续担任领导者。

cues.en: And what we do in RAFT is that that old leader
cues.zh: 在 RAFT 中我们的做法是，那个旧领导者

cues.en: steps down right at this point. Once c new gets committed, the old leader
cues.zh: 就在此时下台。一旦 c new 被提交，旧领导者

cues.en: steps down
cues.zh: 就下台

cues.en: if
cues.zh: 如果

cues.en: it's not
cues.zh: 它不在

cues.en: in the new configuration.
cues.zh: 新配置中。

cues.en: So at that point,
cues.zh: 所以到那时，

cues.en: the other followers will time out and they will elect a new leader, and now at this point that new leader will have to be elected from the new configuration,
cues.zh: 其他跟随者会超时，然后选举出新领导者，此时新领导者必须从新配置中选出，

cues.en: and we're off and running.
cues.zh: 然后我们就继续运行了。

cues.en: But even so, this actually means that
cues.zh: 但即便如此，这实际上意味着

cues.en: the old leader will continue to serve as leader for a little while
cues.zh: 旧领导者还会继续担任领导者一小段时间

cues.en: after it
cues.zh: 在它

cues.en: is no longer part of the configuration. It'll be operating under c new
cues.zh: 不再属于配置之后。它将在 c new 下运行

cues.en: in which it's not actually a leader, but it will continue to serve as leader until that entry
cues.zh: 在其中它实际上不是领导者，但它会继续担任领导者，直到那个条目

cues.en: gets replicated
cues.zh: 被复制

cues.en: enough to be committed.
cues.zh: 到足以提交。

cues.en: This brings us to the end of the RAFT presentation.
cues.zh: 以上就是 RAFT 演示的全部内容。

cues.en: Let me conclude by just reminding you of the six major pieces of the algorithm.
cues.zh: 最后，我来回顾一下这个算法的六个主要部分。

cues.en: The first piece is leader election,
cues.zh: 第一部分是领导者选举，

cues.en: in which we make sure that at most one server can act as leader in any given term.
cues.zh: 我们要确保在任意给定的任期内，最多只有一台服务器能充当领导者。

cues.en: Second, I described the normal operation of the system where leaders accept requests from clients and replicate them across the cluster.
cues.zh: 第二，我介绍了系统的正常运行方式，即领导者接收客户端请求，并将其复制到整个集群。

cues.en: And remember the very important
cues.zh: 还记得那个非常重要的

cues.en: consistency check performed in append entries, which guarantees
cues.zh: 在追加条目时执行的一致性检查，它保证了

cues.en: the behavior of the logs and provides a hook that we can use to restore consistency later on.
cues.zh: 日志的行为，并提供了一个钩子，供我们之后恢复一致性使用。

cues.en: Then third, I talked about leader changeovers,
cues.zh: 然后是第三部分，我讲了领导者切换，

cues.en: and there were two major issues. The most important one is guaranteeing the safety of the system. And I showed you how we can guarantee that once a log entry has been committed, it will live forever.
cues.zh: 这里有两个主要问题。最重要的是保证系统的安全性。我向大家展示了如何保证一旦某条日志条目被提交，它就会永久存在。

cues.en: And I also talked about how a server can make sure all of the followers logs eventually become identical to its own.
cues.zh: 我还讲了服务器如何确保所有跟随者的日志最终都与自己的日志完全一致。

cues.en: Fourth step is making sure that old leaders can't come back to haunt us after we've replaced them.
cues.zh: 第四步是确保旧领导者在被替换后不会卷土重来。

cues.en: Then I talked briefly
cues.zh: 接着我简要讲了

cues.en: about how clients behave, and in particular what they need to do in order to survive crashes of some of the servers in Raft.
cues.zh: 客户端的行为，特别是它们需要做什么才能在 Raft 中部分服务器崩溃时继续存活。

cues.en: And then finally, I showed you how the Raft system can handle configuration changes in a way that is automatic and completely safe.
cues.zh: 最后，我向大家展示了 Raft 系统如何以自动且完全安全的方式处理配置变更。

cues.en: Just one overall comment before I conclude, is that the key element of this algorithm is that the system has to work perfectly even if just a bare majority of the servers are up, which means it can't ever depend on having complete information or knowledge of what's going on. There could always be information out there in servers that are down that's unknown.
cues.zh: 最后总结一下，这个算法的关键在于：即使只有略多于半数的服务器在线，系统也必须完美运行。这意味着它不能依赖完整的信息，也不能要求知道所有情况，因为宕机的服务器上可能始终有未知的信息。

cues.en: And so the algorithm has to be designed at every point to be able to handle that.
cues.zh: 因此，算法在设计的每个环节都必须能够处理这种情况。

cues.en: Alright, well this concludes the presentation on RAFT.
cues.zh: 好了，关于 RAFT 的演讲到此结束。
